parameters.code: var panel = UnityEngine.Object.FindAnyObjectByType<SpaceTaxi.UI.OnboardComputerPanel>(); var texts = panel.GetComponentsInChildren<TMPro.TextMeshProUGUI>(true); var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(); foreach (var t in texts) { var path = t.transform.name; var p = t.transform.parent; while (p != null && p != panel.transform) { path = p.name + "/" + path; p = p.parent; } sb.Append(path).Append(" active=").Append(t.gameObject.activeInHierarchy).Append(" rect=").Append(t.rectTransform.rect.size.x.ToString("0")).Append("x").Append(t.rectTransform.rect.size.y.ToString("0")).Append(" chars=").Append(t.textInfo.characterCount).Append(" meshX=").Append(t.mesh.bounds.size.x.ToString("0.0")).Append(" text=[").Append(t.text.Length > 30 ? t.text.Substring(0, 30) : t.text).Append("]\n"); } return sb.ToString();
